_note: Pros/cons written by Claude from the pooled Myntra review text captured in raw_reviews_<run>.json for the same run. No external LLM API is involved.
_quality_rules: Only attributes of the PRODUCT count. Seller and marketplace problems are excluded — wrong size shipped, damaged or missing boxes, slow delivery, out-of-stock, doubts about authenticity. Those reflect fulfilment, not what the brand designed and made.

A theme is included when several reviewers independently raise it. Where a single review is specific and materially important it is still included, and is explicitly marked as coming from one reviewer so its weight is clear.
Where a brand's own product has too few reviews to read, that is stated rather than padded out.
